description: Object-space painting of the accepted horn, fuzz_face, eye and mouth studies. Metres unless labelled mm. x is absolute distance from symmetry plane.

nape_join.description: Round 2: reshape only the rear streak behind z=0.52 m. Ease its inner cheek edge into a rounded, descending occiput ribbon. Read body/source/joins.json nape.profile.depth_stations[0] for 15 mm profile depth at the neck top ring. Body categorical fibre tips take precedence within 1.5 mm of the geometric cut; interleave to 4 mm.
nape_join.upper_boundary: Falls from y=1.400 at z=0.50 to y=1.379 at z=0.39; charcoal continues down to the body cut. The ivory crown stays above it.
nape_join.profile_measurement: Perpendicular YZ inset from live head/neck rear silhouette; abs(normal.x) < 0.04 and normal.z < -0.2; 2 mm bins, resampled every 0.5 mm. Mirrored in x.

streak_description: Accepted eye and anterior cheek unchanged. Behind z=0.52 m the inner edge rises gently into a rounded turn, then descends as a 15 mm profile ribbon to the body nape.

horn_surface.description: Subtract the elongated component from the accepted base, height and packed tile. Keep source pits and soft isotropic mottling at their original scale.

fuzz_calibration_note: Retain accepted round-one feedback material gains before the round-two colour-only occiput reshape; moving the dye boundary must not rebalance the eye or face material.
